item.title: Meet at the puppet show
item.context_text: Your cousin is going to a puppet show with you. He has the old time and does not know where to wait.
item.objective_text: Give the right time and arrange a meeting place.
success_conditions: Give the right time and arrange a meeting place.

children.title: Read the situation
children.instructions: Read the information and answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
PUPPET SHOW
New start time: Saturday at two, not one. Doors open at half past one. Meet your group outside the shop next to the theatre. The theatre is closed on Sunday.

questions.prompt: When does the show now start?
questions.explanation: The notice changes the start to Saturday at two.
The notice names the shop beside the theatre.

children.title: Correct the time
children.prompt_text: Cousin: Is the start still at one?
children.instructions: Send the new time and meeting place.
children.model_answer: It starts at two on Saturday. Please meet me outside the shop by the theatre.

children.title: Ask about the doors
children.instructions: Say you are here for the puppet show and ask when you can go in.
children.model_answer: Hello, I'm here for the puppet show. What time do the doors open?
